name: bz-corporate-income-tax
description: Belize business tax for companies, partnerships and self-employed persons in tax year 2026. Belize taxes business on gross receipts at the Ninth Schedule rates of the Income and Business Tax Act (1.75% trade, 3% rents, 6% professions, 15% commissions and more), not on net profit. Covers who pays, the receipts base, monthly returns and payment by the 15th, refunds for small traders and professionals, the 5% tax on foreign gains of companies, withholding on contract payments, dividends and payments to non-residents, penalties and interest. Trigger phrases include Belize business tax, Belize company tax, gross receipts tax Belize, BTS business tax return, Belize withholding tax and Belize LLC tax.
